coverage.member: FusionTextArea(this InputBoundField<TModel, TProp> setup, Action<TextAreaBuilder> build)
coverage.catches: the FusionTextArea builder stops rendering the textarea bound to the model value (the test asserts the care log opens with last shift's note already in the field and committed)
the Input event selector stops firing the reactive handler while the caregiver edits, so the live preview never updates as they type
the Input event arg contract stops delivering the payload into the plan, so editing the note shows neither the live preview nor the prior text
Value stops carrying the freshly typed text (the test asserts the live preview reads 'Hydration encouraged at lunch.' after editing)
PreviousValue stops carrying the text before the edit (the test asserts the 'before this keystroke' line still reads last shift's note)
the Changed event selector stops firing when the committed text changes and focus leaves, so the committed record never updates after an edit
the Changed event arg contract stops delivering the commit payload, so finishing an edit records neither the committed note nor what it replaced
Value stops carrying the committed text (the test asserts the committed note reads 'Hydration encouraged at lunch.' after blur)
PreviousValue stops carrying the prior committed text (the test asserts the 'this save will replace' line reads last shift's note)

IsInteracted stops distinguishing a programmatic SetValue (false -> 'filled, not edited by hand') from a hand-typed edit (true -> 'edited by you'); the test types an edit then restores and asserts the status flips to the not-edited-by-hand branch
the Focus event selector stops firing when the caregiver opens the note, so the 'editing now' status never appears
the Focus event arg contract stops delivering the payload, so opening the note shows neither the editing status nor the note-on-file snapshot
Value stops carrying the text on file when focus arrives (the test asserts the focus snapshot reads last shift's note)
the .Reactive wiring stops connecting the textarea's events to their plan pipelines, so focusing the note runs no reaction and the status never changes
the Blur event selector stops firing when the caregiver leaves the note, so the 'autosave pending' status never appears
the Blur event arg contract stops delivering the payload, so leaving the note shows neither the autosave status nor the held-value snapshot
Value stops carrying the text held in the field when focus leaves (the test asserts the blur snapshot reads last shift's note)
FocusIn stops moving focus into the textarea (the test clicks 'Resume editing' and asserts the textarea becomes focused)
FocusOut stops removing focus from the textarea (the test focuses the note, clicks 'Done documenting', and asserts the textarea is no longer focused)

coverage.member: SetValue(this ComponentRef<FusionTextArea, TModel> self, string? value)
coverage.catches: SetValue stops writing the given text onto the field (the test types a draft, restores, and asserts the textarea value returns to last shift's note)
the Value source stops yielding the current note into the gather body (the test asserts the POST carries "careNote":"Hydration encouraged at lunch.")
